message:
fix(apk): a sent X down's owed release is its own record -- a later down of the button refused or dropped no longer hides it (keepalive-r2 e r3, Codex apk_xfence r2 N1)

r2 kept one state per button per side, so a later down overwrote the debt of a down the host had
already received: refused at the entry, the up after X came back was refused (entryRefused); dropped
at sending, Sent became Dropped and the up was dropped too (Codex probe). Now owed_ (set when a sent
down was answered, cleared only when its up was sent and answered) stands apart from entryHeld_ /
entryRefused_ / dropped_: an up goes whenever the button is held or owed and the host takes X; to a
host without X never. A refused / dropped press's held bit is hidden only while nothing of the
button is held.

Test: 67/67 x6 (new: both paths x {X back, still no X} on the wire -- exactly one X1 up to the X
host, none without X, park then confirms with nothing to release, X2 and left unaffected; and the
ledger alone). The same test on 50340ce's ledger: 7 FAIL. 21 consumer targets build; role_park
13/13, prelogin_select 60/60.
